title: Installing without breaking anything
hook: Venvs, constraints, dry runs, a container with no way out, and a smoke test. How to try a pack so that a bad one costs you nothing.

verified.claim: Constraints files only control which version is installed, not whether it is installed.
pip install --dry-run prints what would be installed without installing it, and --report writes a JSON report.
venv creates a separate environment, isolated by default from the base environment's packages.
docker network create --internal restricts external access, and docker's mounts can be read-only.

unchecked: A sandbox lowers the risk and doesn't remove it. Container escapes exist, and we don't claim any setup is proof against one.
